laws.rule: National park entry (general rate, which applies to foreign visitors), daily pass from 1 June 2026: Los Alerces and Lago Puelo ARS 35,000 each. Children 0 to 6 free. Flexipass 3- and 7-day passes are also sold. (No RBA rate for ARS; at the Banco Central de la República Argentina rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 1,078.2486 ARS: ARS 35,000 ≈ A$32.46)
laws.heading: Pase diario

laws.rule: In Península Valdés a drone may be flown only with a permit issued by the provincial Ministerio de Turismo y Áreas Protegidas. Without one you can't operate it, and you can be sanctioned.

In Península Valdés you must stay on the marked roads: vehicles (quads, motorbikes, 4x4) aren't allowed on beaches, and off-road driving isn't allowed. The only place to camp in the area is Puerto Pirámides. Hunting is banned and fishing is restricted.
In Península Valdés, collecting fossil or archaeological remains and plants isn't allowed. Don't feed or disturb wildlife. Pets can't get out of the vehicle inside the protected area.

layers.process: Península Valdés protected natural area, entry ticket per person per day under Resolución 40/2026 (Ministerio de Turismo y Áreas Protegidas): foreign visitors aged 12 and over ARS 50,000 (about A$46.37); children 6 to 11 ARS 25,000 (about A$23.19); under 6s and people with a disability free. A rented vehicle pays ARS 15,000 (about A$13.91) per entry; tourism-agency vehicles, taxis and remises pay ARS 3,300 to 5,300 by seats. Payment is electronic only (debit, credit or QR code). (No RBA rate for ARS; at the Banco Central de la República Argentina rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 1,078.2486 ARS).
